visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt, a silver necklace with a 'J' pendant, and a black ring, holds a black Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra box. He is smiling and gesturing towards the camera in a brightly lit indoor bedroom setting with a bed in the background. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the black box, which features a minimalist graphic of the phone and stylus. The man's hands, wearing a silver bracelet and rings, rotate the box to show different angles. (3) The man holds the box steady and uses his thumb and forefinger to peel away a black security seal from the bottom edge. His facial expression shows focused excitement. (4) He continues to peel a second security seal from the top of the box. The lighting highlights the matte texture of the packaging. (5) He lifts the lid of the box to reveal a silver/titanium-colored smartphone. He smiles broadly, looking directly at the camera with a sense of accomplishment. (6) A close-up shows him peeling a black protective film off the front of the smartphone screen in one swift motion. (7) He holds the sleek, reflective smartphone up, showcasing the large camera lenses on the back and the flat edges of the device.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone, his voice clear and resonant against a very quiet indoor background. No music is present. (2) As he shows the box, his speech rate remains brisk and engaging. (3) A sharp, distinct 'crackle' and 'rip' sound is heard as he removes the security tape, followed immediately by a loud, high-arousal exclamation 'Wa sai!'. (4) The speaker hums a celebratory melody ('Deng deng deng...') with a playful tone. (5) Another clear ripping sound occurs as the screen film is removed, characterized by high spectral brightness. (6) The speaker concludes with a confident, authoritative yet friendly narration about the phone's future use, with no background noise interference.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to create excitement and provide an early unboxing experience of the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra. By using a first-person vlog style and emphasizing being 'the first in Taiwan' to own the device, the creator leverages novelty and exclusivity to engage tech enthusiasts.
